title: Which tools does your AI love using the most on its own? For me, it’s definitely the Python-based tools Claude wrote itself to fix sprites and crop images, also it made like three different bots for testing the game.
author: Bavariasnaps

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: python is default for most models.  I built my own tools with claude that is uses to speed things along, including some mcp driven ones so I can make changes in a gui while it works from the mcp server

replies.body: ah yes cool I had a similiar Idea for me. I have an rpg games with monsters and heroes and thought a visual editor might be cool where I can check the animation and stats for alle heroes and monsters. would be faster to change and find mistakes than with claude. its crazy how many tool I made until today. my newest one is a character consistency tool to make marketing image generation for the game more consistance. Like an image of the 4 main characters looking at the sunset for example without the AI messing up all the faces and details.
